svg.title: Home infrastructure network topology
svg.desc: Network source and operator observations as of 2026-10-10: one control plane, three workers, Synology on VLAN400, Argo adoption complete, and ExternalDNS webhook timeout unresolved.
svg.text: Repository topology + operator evidence · pending items dashed · updated 2026-10-10

g.text: Core router · VLAN gateway · authoritative DHCP · DNS · native TFTP · firewall/NAT
NAS, storage appliance and VMM host · Bond 1 / syno1
Two VMM guests · single control plane / no etcd redundancy
Future VLAN 500 storage and VLAN 900 WAN transit
are reserved ideas, not active architecture.

svg.text: Operator evidence: NAS .40.5 live; Pi workers .41/.42 Ready; TV and Mac DLNA discovery works. Printer Wi-Fi move / Guest printing await confirmation.

g.text: Implemented Home Cloud · Talos 1.14.2 / Kubernetes 1.37.1 / Cilium 1.20.2
Two AMD64 VMs + two ARM64 Pis. One etcd member; all Synology LUNs share the NAS failure domain.
VM boot assets: current ID / HTTP menu
VLAN400 nodes .21 / .40 / .41 / .42 · DHCP reservations · BGP ASN65001 → router ASN65000
RAID10 / Btrfs backing · tested persistent LUN
Validated storage: provision → attach → write → pod replacement → controlled worker reboot + remount; backup restore still untested.
ExternalDNS recovery · backup restore · Quantum standalone boot · independent storage
Source YAML + persistent private PKI → generated Talos configs. Container images and pinned charts still require public upstreams.
Application layer · adopted in Argo (operator status 2026-10-10)
Already working: four Cilium peers ASN 65001 ↔ RB5009 ASN 65000 · LB pool 10.40.0.0/24 · allocated VIP /32 advertisements only
Bootstrap/recovery remains operator-run. Current platform and workload apps are adopted; do not alternate Helm/direct apply and Argo managers.
All 14 apps Synced; 13 Healthy. ExternalDNS Progressing / crash loop; resource health does not prove service or renewal acceptance.
Argo-owned · write-enabled / upsert-only · /records webhook timeout unresolved
Dedicated account · source restrictions · no explicit name-exclusion regex in current values

svg.text: Operator evidence + repository source, 2026-10-10. See docs/gitops.md, docs/external-dns.md and incidents/postmortems/ for status and limitations.
